adults.description: Number of adult guests across all rooms.

checkInDate.description: Check-in date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Must be in the future and earlier than `checkOutDate`.

checkOutDate.description: Check-out date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Must be later than `checkInDate`.

children.description: Number of child guests across all rooms (0–10). Pass `0` if there are no children.

childrenAges.description:
Comma-separated list of child ages, one entry per child (each `0`–`17`). Required when `children > 0` and the number of ages must equal `children`.

Example: `1,3,7`

currency.description: Currency of the prices returned in the response. Use `hotelCurrency` to keep each property's native currency. Provide one exact documented value (52 allowed), e.g. `hotelCurrency`, `usd`.

language.description: Language of the Booking.com interface and localized fields in the response.

url.description: Full Booking.com URL of the property page. Only `booking.com` and `www.booking.com` hosts are accepted.
